title: 第9章 偶遇三人第10章 转职修仙者
slug: 永恒降临全民开局末世求生
content_zh:
收起木纹剑，苏墨走向赵敢当，拍了拍他的后背，给予些许安慰。
过了几分钟，赵敢当才缓解过来，整个人呆呆地愣坐在原地，苏墨没有打扰他。
有些时候，人并不需要所谓的安慰，正常人都有着自己的思想，自己发现的答案或他人给予的答案，这两个根本就没有可比性。
苏墨走向上午在森林发现的一个池塘，清洗了一下木纹剑，用起来还是挺趁手的，毕竟前世苏墨用的最多的就是剑了。
听到身后有脚步声，苏墨立刻警觉，一个脸色略显苍白的壮汉走近，这壮汉就是赵敢当了。
“漱漱口吧。”
苏墨看着赵敢当的样子，提醒道：“别喝下去了，可能会有debuff。”
在野外不要随便喝生水，不知道里面含有什么东西，最好还是煮开喝，至于漱口什么的，都是小问题。
猛吐过后，赵敢当只感觉自己嘴里面充满着胃酸的味道，现在也没有解锁盛水的容器，也只能用手捧凑合一下了。
很快天空就阴沉下来，代表此时已经进入黄昏。
按照永恒降临之前的时间计算的话，以秋季为例，白天占一天的一半，黄昏和夜晚平分剩下的一半。
“走了，我们要赶紧出森林，夜晚尽量别待在森林里过夜。”
苏墨带头向外走，黄昏的森林蒙上了一层诡异的薄纱，更显几分阴森，赵敢当紧跟在苏墨后边。
不用担心迷路，除了特殊区域，否则面板上右下角有地图记录，只要有些方向感的人都可以走出去，如果没有方向感，那就自求多福吧。
来到丧尸的尸体旁，丧尸之类不属于永恒生物的范畴是没有选择处理方式的，放在地上一天，就会被交替的能量磨灭，倒也不用担心污染土地。
掰下一小根树木，从丧尸脑袋里挑出晶核，脑水差不多流完了，轻轻一搅，碰到一个偏硬的物体，用劲一挑，一颗灰白色的晶体飞出。
苏墨走到晶核落地的地方将其捡起，上面倒是没有什么液体，倒不如说是晶核的能量将自己与脑水隔开。
晶核是纯能量晶体，还是比较精纯的那种，类似的能量体，还有妖丹、灵石…，各有各的用途，不过晶核好像到六阶就顶天了，反正苏墨是没有见过六阶以上的晶核，不过也有可能是他没接触到。
继续前进，今天一趟收获满满，苏墨和赵敢当两个人运气都不错能开出来两件物品，真的可以算是比较欧了，至于剩下的一个木箱，只能说有缘无份，木箱钥匙可不是这么容易爆的。
在傍晚之前赶回了昨晚那个营地，科学一本还在原地，不过远远望去有营火在燃烧，显然有人发现了这个地方。

接近营地时，苏墨看见一个尖嘴猴腮的男人，对面还坐着两个穿着都市丽人装束的女人，男人不厌其烦地找女人聊着天。
“郑俊兴，你能不能别讲话了，吵得我烦死了。”
“好好好，我这不是关心你们嘛，问一下你们等会吃什么，是吃烤兔子还是烤胡萝卜…”
男人还是自顾自地讲着，俨然一副舔狗的做派。
见到苏墨和赵敢当靠近，三人都表示出了防备姿态。
在这荒郊野外，突然出现两人，尤其赵敢当看上去人高马大，是个人都多少会有些防备。
苏墨没有过多的解释什么，倒是赵敢当上前说道：“这是俺和苏兄昨天休息的地方，那个科学一本还是苏兄做的呢。”
两个女人中比较温婉的开口说话，“我们本来到此就是想找人一起在这末世中互相扶持，不如就一起吧。”
“不行不行，苏婷，他们是什么样的人都不知道就随便加入我们的队伍，万一他们居心不良怎么办。”
content_en:
Putting away the wood grain sword, Su Mo walked towards Zhao Gandang, patted his back and gave him some comfort.
After a few minutes, Zhao Gandang regained his composure and sat there blankly. Su Mo did not disturb him.
Sometimes, people don't need so-called comfort. Normal people have their own thoughts, answers they find themselves or answers given by others. There is no comparison between the two.
Su Mo walked to a pond he found in the forest that morning and cleaned the wood grain sword. It was quite handy to use. After all, the sword was what Su Mo used most in his previous life.
Hearing the sound of footsteps behind him, Su Mo immediately became alert, and a strong man with a slightly pale face approached. This strong man was Zhao Gandang.
"Rinse your mouth."
Su Mo looked at Zhao Gandang's look and reminded: "Don't drink it, there may be a debuff."
Don't drink raw water casually in the wild. You don't know what's in it. It's better to boil it and drink it. As for gargling your mouth, it's a minor issue.
After vomiting violently, Zhao Gandang only felt that his mouth was filled with the taste of stomach acid. He had not yet unlocked the water container, so he could only hold it with his hands.
Soon the sky became gloomy, indicating that it was already dusk.
Calculated according to the time before the advent of eternity, taking autumn as an example, daytime accounts for half of the day, and dusk and night equally divide the remaining half.
"Let's go, we need to get out of the forest quickly, and try not to stay in the forest overnight."
Su Mo took the lead and walked out. The forest at dusk was covered with a strange veil, making it even more eerie. Zhao Gandang followed Su Mo closely.
Don’t worry about getting lost. Except for special areas, there is a map record in the lower right corner of the panel. Anyone with a sense of direction can go out. If you don’t have a sense of direction, then just ask for luck.
When we come to the corpse of a zombie, there is no choice in how to deal with zombies and other non-eternal creatures. If they are left on the ground for a day, they will be wiped out by the alternating energy. There is no need to worry about contaminating the land.
Break off a small tree root and pick out the crystal core from the zombie's head. The brain water has almost finished flowing. He stirs it gently and hits a hard object. When he picks it hard, a gray-white crystal flies out.
Su Mo walked to the place where the crystal core fell and picked it up. There was no liquid on it, but rather it was the energy of the crystal core that separated him from the brain water.
The crystal core is a pure energy crystal, which is relatively pure. There are similar energy bodies, demon pills, spirit stones, etc., each with its own use. However, the crystal core seems to reach the sky at the sixth level. Anyway, Su Mo has never seen a crystal core above the sixth level, but it is possible that he has not come into contact with it.
Moving on, today's trip was full of rewards. Su Mo and Zhao Gandang were both lucky enough to be able to get two items, which can be considered relatively good. As for the remaining wooden box, it can only be said that they are destined to be together. The key to the wooden box is not so easy to explode.
I rushed back to the camp last night before evening. The science book was still there, but there was a campfire burning from a distance, so someone had obviously discovered this place.
When approaching the camp, Su Mo saw a man with a sharp mouth and monkey cheeks. Opposite him were two women wearing urban beauty attires. The men took the trouble to chat with the women.
"Zheng Junxing, can you stop talking? It's annoying me to death."
"Okay, okay, I don't care about you. I want to ask you what you're going to eat later, whether it's roasted rabbit or roasted carrots..."
The man was still talking to himself, acting like a dog-licker.
Seeing Su Mo and Zhao Gandang approaching, the three of them all expressed their defensive posture.
In this wilderness, two people suddenly appeared, especially Zhao Gandang, who looked tall and strong, so everyone would be somewhat defensive.
Su Mo didn't explain too much, but Zhao Gan stepped forward and said, "This is where Brother Su and I rested yesterday. That science book was written by Brother Su."The more gentle of the two women spoke, "We originally came here to find someone to support each other in this apocalypse, so why not do it together."
"No, no, Su Ting, they just join our team casually without knowing what kind of people they are. What if they have bad intentions?"
